description: The world's leading flight-compensation company, founded in 2013 and headquartered in Gdańsk, Poland: it helps passengers claim compensation for delayed, cancelled or overbooked flights (charging a fee on successful claims) and sells the AirHelp+ membership.

evidence.summary: AirHelp's own affiliate page publishes the program terms: 15% commission on AirHelp's fee for approved claims (average payout €75 per claim), 20% on AirHelp+ memberships, 30-day cookie, open to creators and publishers, joinable directly or via an affiliate network.

AirHelp's own blog post on the program (updated Oct 12, 2026) states under 'Attractive Commissions' that 'there is no limit to how much you can earn' — an explicit no-earnings-cap statement, so commission_cap is uncapped.
Founded in 2013 and headquartered in Gdansk, Poland, AirHelp is described as the world's leading flight compensation company with more than 550 employees.

name: AirHelp

reasons.compensation: Published two-part rates (15% of AirHelp's fee on approved claims; 20% on AirHelp+ memberships) plus an explicit no-limit earnings statement on the brand's own blog — top band.
reasons.contact_access: A public program page with direct sign-up, but no published program email was found.
reasons.credibility: Founded 2013 in Gdańsk; described as the world's leading flight-compensation company with 550+ employees.
reasons.niche_fit: Flight delays and compensation are core travel-creator content, and the product converts from exactly the disruption stories travel audiences already watch.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application on the brand's own site or via affiliate networks.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand's own affiliate page explicitly recruits creators and publishers, with direct and network sign-up routes.

description: London-based travel eSIM provider founded in 2023, selling prepaid mobile data plans for 200+ destinations that activate in seconds by QR code, with taxes included in the price shown.

evidence.summary: eSIM Air's own affiliate page publishes tiered commissions — Starter 12%, Growth 16% at 50+ sales/month, Elite 20% at 200+ sales/month — with a 30-day cookie and monthly payouts from $50 by bank transfer or PayPal across 200+ destinations.

The same page states 'No caps · Monthly payouts' and 'Transparent 12–20% rates with no caps and no surprises' — an explicit no-cap statement on the brand's own program page, so commission_cap is uncapped.
CB Insights profile: eSIM Air was founded in 2023 and is based in London, England, providing global eSIM connectivity for individual consumers and enterprise clients.

The brand's own About page names the registered entity as eSIM Air LLC and describes tier-one carrier partnerships with instant QR-code activation; the brand is small and young, so program longevity is unproven.

name: eSIM Air

reasons.compensation: Published tiered rates (12% starter, 16% at 50+ sales/mo, 20% at 200+ sales/mo) with an explicit 'no caps' statement on the brand's own page.
reasons.contact_access: Application route on the brand's own site; no published program email was found.
reasons.credibility: Founded 2023 and London-based per CB Insights; a small, young brand with a thin public footprint, so longevity is unproven.
reasons.niche_fit: Travel eSIMs are a staple recommendation in travel content, and the product is demo-friendly (buy before you fly, scan a QR code, land connected).
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open affiliate application on the brand's own page.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The affiliate page addresses partners generally; no creator-specific program or UGC showcase was found.

description: The UK's leading cheap-flight finding membership service: members get alerts on mistake fares and unusually cheap flights, with a community of over 4 million members across the UK, Northern Europe and the US.

evidence.summary: Awin's own merchant profile for Jack's Flight Club advertises a 'High 20% commission rate on sales' — affiliates are paid when a referred member joins or upgrades to paid membership — with approval-first applications via a partnership questionnaire.

The brand's own affiliate page says tracking and commissions are managed with ShareASale (US) and Awin (UK), gives affiliates@jacksflightclub.com for tools and support, and pays commission on any purchase within 30 days of the first visit; it states the community exceeds 4 million members who saved £30 million on flights in the last year.

The brand's own Instagram post (Nov 12, 2026) announces a separate creator Ambassador Program run via Impact.com, paying 10% commission per referral with monthly payouts — a distinct creator route from the 20% network affiliate program.
Lasso's directory independently lists the Jack's Flight Club affiliate program at 20% per sale with a 30-day cookie, matching the Awin profile.

name: Jack's Flight Club

reasons.compensation: Awin's own profile and Lasso both publish 20% per sale; the separate Impact ambassador route pays 10% per referral.
reasons.contact_access: A published affiliate team email (affiliates@jacksflightclub.com) plus a dedicated management team described on the brand's own page.
reasons.credibility: The UK's leading cheap-flight membership service per Awin; 4M+ members and £30M saved in a year per the brand's own page.
reasons.niche_fit: Cheap-flight alerts are a proven travel-content category, and the membership product is built for sharing.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Approval-first: Awin applications require a partnership questionnaire/business case, usually decided within 24 hours per the profile.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Alongside the network program, the brand runs a creator Ambassador Program on Impact that it promotes on its own Instagram.

description: Palo Alto, California-based mobile data company founded in 2010, providing eSIM data plans to travelers in 200+ destinations plus cruise and inflight connectivity; an official Visa partner that has served over a million travelers.

evidence.summary: GigSky's own Partner With Us page lists an affiliate model among its partnership options (alongside API resale and bulk sales) and states the company has served 1M+ travelers across 200+ destinations and 200+ cruise ships and is an official Visa partner.

GigSky's public affiliate program listing (via Affluxo) states all conversions are tracked through Everflow using approved tracking links, paying 15% revshare on purchases plus flat CPA bounties: $25 per GigSky One purchase, $4 per Visa benefit redemption and $3 per free plan redemption; content sites and blogs are allowed traffic sources.

YonoSIM's October 2026 comparison, checked against brands' own pages, lists GigSky at 15% direct and 20% via Travelpayouts with a 30-day cookie — the higher figure is a network channel variant, not a conflict.

GigSky also runs a separate tiered travel-agent program (10% rising to 20% by sales volume) for agencies and consultants; that trade program is NOT the basis of this entry — the consumer affiliate program above is.
GigSky is a Palo Alto, California-based mobile technology company founded in 2010 that provides eSIM and SIM card-based data services to international travelers.

name: GigSky

reasons.compensation: Published 15% revshare on purchases plus flat CPA bounties ($25 GigSky One, $4 Visa redemption, $3 free plan) on the public Everflow listing.
reasons.contact_access: A partnership page on the brand's own site, but no published affiliate email was found.
reasons.credibility: Founded 2010 in Palo Alto, an official Visa partner with 1M+ travelers served per its own site.
reasons.niche_fit: Travel eSIM/data is a standard travel-creator recommendation; GigSky also covers cruise and inflight data, a distinctive angle.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Public program listing open to content publishers; the separate travel-agent tiers are trade-only and are not the basis of this entry.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The public program listing allows content sites and blogs; no creator-specific program page was found.

description: The UK market leader for travel add-ons: airport parking, airport hotels, airport lounges (UK and international) and travel insurance, sold online with cancellation protection and money-saving extras.

evidence.summary: Holiday Extras' own affiliate introduction page states: 'As an affiliate you can earn 2% commission on every booking' via banners, text links, product or XML feeds; the sign-up link routes to Affiliate Window (Awin), and the page links an affiliate-team email for partner help. No earnings-cap statement is published, so the cap is unknown.

name: Holiday Extras

reasons.compensation: The brand's own page publishes a clear 2% on every booking — a low rate, but first-party, published and unambiguous.
reasons.contact_access: The brand's own affiliate page links an affiliate-team email and routes sign-up through Awin.
reasons.credibility: UK market leader for travel add-ons with an award-winning reputation, per its own program page.
reasons.niche_fit: Airport parking, hotels, lounges and insurance are practical add-ons travel creators routinely bundle into trip-planning content.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open sign-up from the brand's own page into Awin (Affiliate Window).
reasons.ugc_evidence: The program is framed for website owners placing links and feeds; no creator-specific program was found.

description: Women's special-occasion and fast-fashion retailer founded in 1937 in Southern California and headquartered in Santa Fe Springs, CA, with 350+ stores plus an online shop — known for prom, homecoming and party dresses.

evidence.summary: Windsor's own affiliate page invites creators and promoters to apply (the apply route runs through Ascend by Partnerize) and publishes affiliate@windsorstore.com for the program; no commission rate or earnings-cap terms are published on the page, so the rate is unpublished and the cap unknown.
Windsor's own press page lists pr@windsorstore.com, corporate headquarters at 9603 John St, Santa Fe Springs, CA 90670, and names its official Instagram and Facebook as @windsorstore.
Windsor Fashions: founded 1937, family-owned by the Zekaria family, 350+ stores, headquartered in Santa Fe Springs, California.

name: Windsor

reasons.compensation: No commission rate or cap terms are published anywhere found, so this stays at or below 5.
reasons.contact_access: A published program email (affiliate@windsorstore.com) plus a PR email on the brand's own press page.
reasons.credibility: Family-owned since 1937, headquartered in Santa Fe Springs, CA, with 350+ stores.
reasons.niche_fit: Occasion dresses (prom, homecoming, parties) are a high-volume fashion UGC category with strong seasonal demand.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application from the brand's own page into Ascend by Partnerize.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A public affiliate page aimed at promoters exists, but no structured creator or ambassador program was found.

description: London streetwear label selling bold menswear and womenswear — signature parachute pants, cargos, dresses and graphic tops — with weekly product launches, monthly collections and worldwide delivery.

evidence.summary: Awin's own merchant profile for Jaded London UK describes the programme: cutting-edge streetwear across menswear and womenswear, signature parachute pants and cargo trousers, weekly product launches and monthly collection launches including collaborations, seeking forward-thinking lifestyle and fashion websites and publications.

LinkClicky's program directory lists Jaded London on the Awin platform (US region), website jadedldn.com, 30-day cookie, with commission not publicly available — so no rate is recorded and the cap is unknown.

name: Jaded London

reasons.compensation: The commission rate is not publicly available (LinkClicky lists N/A), so this stays at or below 5.
reasons.contact_access: Network-only route through Awin; no published brand contact for the program was found.
reasons.credibility: Established London label with worldwide delivery and regular collection launches and collaborations.
reasons.niche_fit: Bold Gen Z streetwear with weekly drops — highly shoppable, social-first fashion.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Application via the Awin merchant profiles (UK and EU programmes).
reasons.ugc_evidence: The Awin profile says the brand wants forward-thinking lifestyle and fashion websites and publications; no separate creator program was found.

evidence.summary: LinkClicky lists the GANT affiliate program on the Awin platform for the US, website gant.com, 30-day cookie, with commission not publicly known.
FMTC's merchant directory lists Gant US on Awin (merchant #32403) and Gant UK on Awin (#27734), confirming live network programs in both markets.

Published rate figures conflict — Lasso quotes 9% per sale for GANT while LinkClicky lists the commission as not publicly available and regional programs differ (GANT.CZ at 1.6%/7.2%) — so no commission rate is recorded and the cap is unknown.
GANT is a Swedish designer fashion brand with American roots, founded in 1949 and headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.

name: GANT

reasons.contact_access: Network-only route through Awin; no published program contact was found.
reasons.credibility: Heritage brand founded 1949, headquartered in Stockholm, sold in some 70 markets.
reasons.niche_fit: Premium preppy apparel fits fashion creators, though the audience skews older than the Gen Z UGC core.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Live Awin programs in the US (#32403) and UK (#27734) per FMTC.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A standard network affiliate program; no creator-specific program or UGC evidence was found.

description: Los Angeles fashion brand founded in 2016 by Emma Grede and Khloé Kardashian, selling size-inclusive women's denim, clothing, swim and shoes designed for a curvier shape.

evidence.summary: Good American's own affiliate registration page on Ascend by Partnerize states approved affiliates 'can earn up to a 10% commission rate on sales' — a ceiling, not a fixed rate, so no rate is recorded and the cap is unknown — gives romina.chuatico@goodamerican.com for program questions, and explicitly asks whether the applicant promotes brands on personal social media or a personal blog.
Good American is an American fashion brand founded in 2016 by Emma Grede and Khloé Kardashian.
Third-party figures vary (Shopper quotes 'up to 5-10%'), consistent with the brand publishing only an up-to-10% ceiling; the exact rate is set per approved affiliate.

name: Good American

reasons.contact_access: A named program contact email is published on the brand's own registration page.
reasons.credibility: Major US brand founded in 2016 by Emma Grede and Khloé Kardashian.
reasons.niche_fit: Size-inclusive denim and apparel is a top-performing fashion UGC category, and the brand markets through creators.

Published US rate figures conflict — Lasso lists 4% per sale on a 7-day cookie, an older review quotes a flat 7%, and Shopper quotes up to 5-10% — so no commission rate is recorded and the cap is unknown.
Review describes the Cotton On Group's brands (Cotton On, Cotton On Kids and Body, Rubi, Typo) and a Rakuten-managed affiliate program covering all of them.

name: Cotton On

reasons.compensation: Published figures conflict (4% US per Lasso, 7% in an older review, up to 5-10% per Shopper), so no rate is recorded.
reasons.contact_access: Network-only route through Rakuten Advertising; no published brand program contact was found.
reasons.credibility: Part of Australia's largest global retailer group; 1,500+ stores in 18 countries per Rakuten.
reasons.niche_fit: Affordable casual fashion for men, women and kids is a staple of haul and styling content.
